answers.question:
Q18. A reviewer found that when the refund call answers OrderNotCancelled, the spec has the agent tell the customer "the order is cancelled" and ask staff for a manual refund, though you accepted only "tells the customer the refund was not issued, and asks staff to follow up with the reason refund not issued". I propose this change to the rule.
Before: "When the refund call returns an error, the agent reports it, does not claim the refund was issued, and asks staff to issue it by the store's manual refund process. After an error the order system will not recover from, or an answer that the order is not cancelled, the agent sends no second refund call."
After: "When the refund call returns an error, the agent reports it, does not claim the refund was issued, and asks staff to issue it by the store's manual refund process. After an error the order system will not recover from, the agent sends no second refund call. When the refund call answers that the order is not cancelled, the agent sends no second refund call, tells the customer the refund was not issued, and asks staff to follow up with the reason refund not issued."

Q19. Your staff task queue takes three reasons: refund not issued, refund status unknown, cancellation unknown. The rule for a refund amount that differs names a fourth, "refund amount differs", which your confirmed tool does not take. I propose this change to the rule.
Before: "When the refund the order system returns, or shows on a new read, has an amount that differs from the amount the customer said yes to, the agent makes no further change with the new amount, tells the customer the amount the order system returned, and asks staff to follow up with the reason refund amount differs."
After: the same, ending "and asks staff to follow up with the reason refund status unknown."
answers.recommended: Yes: the task carries the reason refund status unknown, one of the three reasons the queue takes.
answers.reply:
Yes, I accept your recommendation.
> Proposed set shown to the user: list_orders() (returns each order with its refund or null), cancel_order(order_number), issue_refund(order_number) (supplied), request_staff_followup(order_number, reason) with reasons refund_not_issued, refund_status_unknown, cancellation_unknown; terminal refund error returns a refund with status failed, transient error creates none; handoff timeout not retried; SG-02 (store staff work every follow-up task) added.

answers.question: Q20. When the first read of the customer's orders fails with an error that is not a timeout, nobody has said what the agent does. The rule now says: "When the read of the customer's orders fails with an error at the start of the conversation, the agent changes nothing and tells the customer it cannot see their orders right now."
answers.recommended: Yes, keep that sentence as the rule.

answers.question:
Q21. While a read keeps timing out, the customer waits and nothing tells the agent what to say. I propose adding one sentence to the rule.
Before: "A read that times out may be retried without limit; only calls that change something are bounded."
After: "A read that times out may be retried without limit; only calls that change something are bounded. While a read keeps timing out, the agent tells the customer once that it is still checking, and reads again until the read answers, fails, or the customer leaves."
answers.reply:
Yes, I accept your recommendation.
> Reads may be retried on timeout without limit; only commit calls are bounded.
